required: all routes can be refreshed directly
defined navigation and static state controls work
each target renders application-owned page DOM and interactions without iframe, redirect, reverse proxy, or runtime reads from docs/前端原型_v2
the target dev/build artifact remains usable after the prototype baseline server is unavailable
fixed viewport screenshots show no overlap, clipping, or incoherent layout shift
all immutable prototypes and targets pass the browser-ready gate before audit dispatch

coder self-audit and route/state tests cannot satisfy visual acceptance
one integrated visual review after all nine pages, not per-control audit tasks

visual_acceptance_protocol.delegation_transport: platform-created independent Codex session with indexed model parameters and source/role-only codex_delegation block; not inline subagent or product Task
normal_state_comparison: same fixed viewport and exact screenshot dimensions
target required regions are present in the target top-level document rather than only inside a framed or proxied prototype document
target network and runtime inspection show no dependency on the prototype baseline server or docs/前端原型_v2
major regions present in the same order with comparable geometry
prototype-specific layout, density, typography, colors, controls, and content hierarchy are retained
no whole-page horizontal overflow, clipping, overlap, or unintended layout shift
non_normal_state_comparison: empty, loading, and error remain inside the accepted page geometry without overlap or clipping
visual_acceptance_protocol.required_result: per-page per-viewport PASS|FAIL|BLOCKED matrix with observed differences, target top-level DOM evidence, runtime independence evidence, and document scrollWidth/innerWidth
visual_acceptance_protocol.fail_closed: any FAIL, BLOCKED, missing pair, prototype load failure, wrong image size, author self-review, framed/proxied prototype, empty target top-level page DOM, target runtime dependency on prototype sources, or duplicate/dead route-canonical page implementation keeps WEB-STATIC-RESTORE IN_PROGRESS
visual_acceptance_protocol.repair_policy: one integrated repair inside the same Task, followed by recheck from the same non-author auditor

allowed_external_resource_handling: runtime URL rewrite that does not change prototype DOM, layout CSS, content, or interactions
required_before_audit: all endpoints become browser-ready without a hanging external dependency
prototype_runtime_gate.failure: BLOCKED or ENVIRONMENT_APPROVAL_REQUIRED; never visual PASS

forbidden: iframe or frame embedding of the prototype
redirect or reverse proxy to a prototype URL
runtime reads from docs/前端原型_v2

target regions exist in the top-level target DOM
target static interactions execute in the target document

build validation includes all target page assets
